text:
sara: Quick idea — can we run a short daily 10-min 'pass-the-baton' triage at 16:45 PST (00:45 UTC)? Keep it strict: 1) quick incident status, 2) handoff notes, 3) rollouts/blockers. Who can make this?

alex: I can do weekdays. 16:30 PST would be slightly better for me but 16:45 works some days.

mike: 16:50 would be better on my end. Also FYI INC-4723 still has a rollback in progress (paging @jamie).

jamie: I'm on INC-4723 rollback now, ETA ~15m. Will give a quick update in the sync if we keep it.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4723: acknowledged by jamie at 1965439800. Current status: rollback in progress.

sara: Proposed agenda (strict 10m):
- 00:00-00:02 quick incident rundown (only open/critical)
- 00:02-00:05 handoff notes + owners (who's primary/secondary)
- 00:05-00:08 blockers/rollouts (short callouts)
- 00:08-00:10 action items + calendar updates

Here's a tiny handoff template I'll paste in the calendar event:```
PRIOR_INCIDENTS: INC-4723, INC-4730
PRIMARY: <name>
SECONDARY: <name>
KEY_NOTES: short one-line status + next step
ACTION_ITEMS: owner - item (ETA)
```

alex: +1 to the agenda. On rotation cadence — do we want daily primaries or weekly? Daily is flexible but noisy.

mike: prefer weekly primary/secondary for continuity. Daily swaps are too many context switches.

sara: OK leaning weekly. Proposal: primary = week cadence, secondary = shadow all week. Backup = on-call overflow. Volunteers?

alex: I can be primary next Mon-Fri (week of 1965444800).

jamie: I can be secondary Tue-Thu. Happy to pick up handoff notes for rollbacks.

sara: Great. Action items:
- sara: update runbook + calendar event (includes template above)
- alex: add primary entry to calendar for next week
- jamie: post rollback summary in the incident thread when done

mike: small timezone note — 16:45 PST is 00:45 UTC; ping APAC teams if we need their input for anything outside this window.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook page last edited 1965400000. Link: https://redwood.runbooks/internal/oncall (internal)

sara: Plan: start this cadence tomorrow, first sync 16:45 PST. If no critical incidents, we'll do a 2-min check and mark 'no-op'. If a large incident is active, we'll extend and move to the incident bridge. Thanks everyone — I'll post the calendar invite now :thumbsup:

alex: Sounds good. See you tomorrow.

jamie: rollback complete, posting summary to INC-4723 now.

oncall-bot: INC-4723: rollback completed at 1965440500; status: verifying.
